note: The advisory has no fix commit and names SimpleSocketServer and SimpleSSLSocketServer, which hand each connection to SocketNode (logback-classic). SocketNode.run reads the object stream through HardenedLoggingEventInputStream in 1.2.12 and 1.5.12 (a plain ObjectInputStream in 1.1.0), and the hardened stream does not stop Proxy classes. The servers are started by a main method or named by class, so no sink reached proves nothing.
